verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Bolna's own MCP server, which lets external assistants such as Claude or Cursor manage a Bolna account. That is the server role and does not show a voice agent consuming MCP servers as tool sources mid-call. The tools tab and integrations evidence describe built-in tools and provider connections, with no mention of MCP-client support, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my voice agent can plug in MCP servers as tool sources so one integration grants it whole toolsets mid-call
